This is one weird country these kids live in (this is also one really weird juvenile detention center). Other than that, it feels a little bit like the Pokemon one I translated by the same artist... only a little bit shittier and more confusing, if you ask me! I don't actually know much about this whole youth reeducation thing.
I apologize for the delay caused by my lazy ass. I'm also sorry for the editing (which I assume is pretty wonky in some areas), since I edited this whole book in about an hour while relatively tired. Let me know if I did a decent job at this one.
(PS: Since these boys technically aren't really people, either, do you think they're getting raped in the assholes behind the scenes? That's something you don't see much in a lot of stuff like this.
Also, I wonder if things like these might become my niche? Of course, I think I'll do other stuff as well once I gain more confidence.)
